items.title: Harvey Jones Interview
items.q: Another boy named George Brown, he was a trumpet player.

ctx.x: He was a trumpet player. Another boy named George Brown, he was a trumpet player. And we had a fella play with us during that time called Jack Molasses. Now he was a guitar player. Another fella played the violin, in those days they called them fiddles. His name was Claire Wilson. And I played drums then with them.
